openclaw.summary: Your always-on AI assistant that runs on your own machine.

s1.title: Pick an app
s1.subtitle: Data from GitHub registry
s1.empty: No apps found. Check your network.
s1.doctorDesc: A quick look at your machine before installing.

s2.title: Checkup report
s2.note: Red items are explained in plain words when you tap them. Nothing here changes your system.

s3.title: Install plan
s3.confirmNote: Nothing runs until you press Install now.

s4.title: Installing
s4.logNote: Log is read-only. Keys are masked.

s5.title: Connect your model
s5.subtitle: Pick one path. You can change it later.
s5.todoNote: This path is not ready yet. Pick one of the paths above.
s5.todoDetail: This path arrives in a later phase. For now, pick one of the three ready paths above — they work today.
s5.stepReg: Sign up on the official site (email is fine).
s5.stepTopup: Top up your balance — a small amount is enough to start.
s5.stepCreateKey: Create an API key and copy the whole string.
s5.shotNote: Step screenshot goes here (from the official guide).
s5.safety1: Never send your key to anyone, including us.
s5.safety2: Blur it out in any screenshot.
s5.safety3: If it leaks, revoke it in the provider dashboard right away.
s5.pasteHint: An API key is a long secret string that lets apps use your account. It is checked here and never leaves your machine.
s5.modelsEmpty: No model list — using built-in defaults.
s5.writeNote: We back up your original file first, then merge — your existing settings are kept.
s5.writeFail: Could not save. Your original file is untouched — try again.
s5.written: Config saved. Next: send one real test message.

s6.title: Real test message
s6.subtitle: We send one real request. A real reply means it works.
s6.failGeneric: No reply from the model. Check your key and try again.
s6.errKey: The provider says this key is not valid (401). Check it in their dashboard.
s6.errNet: Network problem — the request never went out. Check your connection and retry.
s6.errWeak: A response came back with no text — that does not count. We need a real model reply.

s7.title: Installed. Really usable.
s7.subtitle: Everything below is on your machine now.
s7.nextDesc: Bind Telegram / WhatsApp and other channels so your AI can reach you.

ss.title: Windows says “unknown publisher”?
ss.intro: Windows SmartScreen shows this the first time you run a downloaded app. It is normal. Four taps and it is gone:
ss.step1: Click “More info” on the blue screen.
ss.step4: The installer opens. You are done.
ss.note: We are an unsigned portable app for now. Signing arrives when we can afford a certificate — never send your key to anyone.

err.title: Something went wrong
err.cancelled: You cancelled the install. Nothing was changed.
err.registry: Could not reach the app list. Check your network and retry.
err.scanFailed: Could not check your system. Retry, or export diagnostics.
err.netDead: All download sources timed out. Check your network, then retry.
err.hashMismatch: The downloaded file doesn't match its checksum — it may be tampered with. Try another source.

resume.title: Continue last install?
resume.desc: Your previous install did not finish. You can pick up where you left off.

net.title: Network settings
net.regionHint: Auto picks the faster route for you.
net.doctorDesc: Test DNS, proxy and download sources.
net.doctorFail: The checkup couldn't run. Check your network and retry.
net.doctorPending: Checkup lands in the next batch — full report with plain-language results.

fixHint.R1: Auto-fix: handled in the background, no action needed
fixHint.R2: Suggested fix: confirm and we'll apply it
fixHint.R3: Advanced fix: needs your explicit approval

net.diagDesc: Package logs, scan report and plan into a zip (no keys).

e1.title: Network trouble
e1.desc: This task failed twice in a row. Here's the latest network check:
e1.r2Advice: Your connection may be behind a proxy or filtered. Try switching the region to Global in Settings → Network, or turn on a proxy — then retry.
e1.failHint: Some download sources are unreachable right now; the installer will keep trying mirrors.

hint.disk: You need at least 5 GB free. Free up some space and try again — nothing else is wrong.
hint.node: Node.js is missing. We will install it for you silently, no admin rights needed.
hint.wsl: WSL is not installed. Only needed by some apps; the plan will skip it if not required.
hint.port: Another AI assistant is already using this port. It does not block installing; you may just pick a different entry later.

key.pastedPage: That looks like you copied a whole web page — copy only the key
key.badFormat: Format does not look right. Keys usually start with sk-
key.tooShort: That is too short — keys are long random strings
key.wrongPrefix: This does not start with {{prefix}} — did you copy the right key?
